name: MuJoCo / Multi-Agent MuJoCo
description: MuJoCo (Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact) is a high-fidelity physics engine for robotics and control research; Multi-Agent MuJoCo extends it to cooperative multi-agent settings where a single simulated body (e.g. ant, humanoid) is factored into multiple independently controlled agents that must coordinate to achieve locomotion tasks.
typical_sota_score: Varies per task; e.g. HalfCheetah ~10 000+ return for top algorithms; MAMuJoCo tasks less saturated.
reputation: MuJoCo is the standard physics engine for continuous RL research; MAMuJoCo is a widely adopted cooperative MARL benchmark.
notes: MuJoCo is now free and open-source (since 2022). MAMuJoCo requires careful credit assignment across agents; many tasks remain unsaturated.
